inputs.label: Başlangıç — start date of the date-to-date calculators (B9, B10)
Bitiş — end date

Spread (bp) — the desk's OIS spread: added to ACT/360 simple rates here, and the default of the forward quote matrix's spread (EK_FWD!D4:E4), Forward!P58 / O27, OIS_MAIN!F122 and EK_TARIH!G2 (two-way: formula default - the spread a value typed in the date-to-date block gives, else the workbook's)
Eğri (+ spread) — the curve of the bulk date-to-date table's last column, its ACT/360 rate + spread (MPC ima / S1 / S2 / S3 / Ağırlıklı / Bootstrap / TLREF sabit)
Gün esası — the basis of the bulk date-to-date table's curve columns (ACT/360, ACT/365, O/N (360): the date-to-date block's D, C, E)
Genel spread (bp) — the bulk date-to-date table's spread of a row without one (formula default: MASA!I60)
Başlangıç — start dates of the bulk date-to-date table (formula default: the OIS spot once the row's end is typed)
Bitiş — end dates of the bulk date-to-date table (100 rows, empty to start with)
Spread (bp) per row of the bulk date-to-date table (formula default: the general spread; two-way: the spread a '+ spread (360)' typed in the row gives)
Kote % per row of the bulk date-to-date table — a rate quoted for the row's dates, read in the table's basis (Gün esası), to read its spread over the chosen TRY OIS curve and Bootstrap (boş başlar)
Kote % (ACT/360) — a rate quoted for the date-to-date block's dates (MASA!C60 / E60), to read its spread over each TRY OIS curve of the block (boş başlar)
Valör — six value dates of the forward pricing table (B14)
Manuel TRY % — manual TRY rate per value date, in percent (35,5 = %35,5; the formulas divide by 100)
Döviz — foreign currency of the forward table
"YAKIN" eşiği (bp) for the VİOP target status (B17)
Ticker — Bloomberg tickers of the 8 macro indicators (B20)
Politika faizi % — current policy rate
Anket ayı — survey month
ECO ticker — Bloomberg ECO ticker for the survey median
dates of 1. toplantı, 2. toplantı, 3. toplantı
Anket % for the three meetings
survey policy rate, current year end (P160 = YEAR(S155)&" sonu")
survey policy rate, 12 ay sonrası
survey policy rate, next year end
12A TÜFE bekl. — survey 12M-ahead annual CPI
Valör — value date of the broken-date converter (B22)
Girdi tipi — convention of the typed quote
Girdi — the quote
Spot (ops.) — optional spot override
z eşiği — z threshold (B23 direction/highlight, B20 highlight)
Kaynak — Bloomberg source suffix for OIS history tickers – masanın ortak verisi
